# Illini Cleaning and Painting

> Full-service home improvement contractor serving Champaign-Urbana and Central Illinois since 2006. Owner: Jermaine Williams. One team handles painting, carpet cleaning, flooring, remodeling, and make-ready units.

## Services

- Painting: Interior, exterior, cabinet refinishing
- Carpet Cleaning: Deep extraction, stain removal, pet treatment
- Flooring: Hardwood, luxury vinyl plank (LVP), tile installation
- Remodeling: Kitchens, bathrooms, full-room transformations
- Make-Ready Units: Rental turnovers for landlords and property managers

## Differentiator

Jermaine Williams, in his own words: "We provide multiple services so clients avoid the hassle of scheduling multiple contractors. We are quicker and more efficient."

## Estimates

- Free, written, no obligation
- 30-minute consultation: phone, video call, or in-person walkthrough
- At least 1 day notice required to schedule
